name: 🔪 Relentless
desc:
[ PUBLIC TESTING PERIOD, EXPECT BUGS & ADJUSTMENTS ]
Report bugs at #bug-reports in our server!

You can't remember what exactly led up to you getting here. All you know is that you're here forever..

🔥 As a SURVIVOR, use your abilities and surroundings to assure your survival. Use the gas stations to get fuel for the generators, and open the exit gates when they're all done.

🔪 As the KILLER, use your abilities to control the match and hunt down and eliminate survivors one by one. Down survivors, carry them to Altars, and sacrifice them to permanently eliminate them from the match.
